# ChunkLit

Kind: tag · Defined in [`src/renderer/lighting/ray_scene.h`](../../../src/renderer/lighting/ray_scene.h) · Described in `data/passes.json`

A chunk whose acceleration structure is in the scene the rays see (or that has no triangle).

## Notes

Added by RayScene::updateChunks once the chunk's bottom level structure is queued (at once when it has no triangle); removed when the chunk loses ChunkTriangles (meshed again); the storage is cleared when RayScene is destroyed. ProbeVolume gives bricks only to ChunkLit chunks. Ray tracing only.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: ProbeVolume. Written by: RayScene. Created by: RayScene. Destroyed by: RayScene.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md) | service | Host | **read** | syncBricks | Only chunks in the rays get a brick. |
| [RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md) | service | Host | **readwrite+create+destroy** | updateChunks, destructor | Added when a chunk is in the rays, removed when it lost ChunkTriangles; cleared at the end. |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[ProbeVolume](../systems/service-ProbeVolume.md)**
  - Allocates pages of 3D probe textures (61 MB each, logged), uploads the brick table and the probe classes.
  - Records the probe dispatches into the frame's compute command buffer.
  - Writes the Context probe pointers read by every view set; waits for the device when its buffer grows.
- **[RayScene](../systems/service-RayScene.md)**
  - Builds and refits acceleration structures in the frame's compute command buffer; allocates their buffers, scratch, geometry table and instance buffers.
  - Writes Context::tlas, ray_geometries and ray_textures, which every view set gets.
  - Connects onChunkGone to on_destroy<ChunkTriangles>; the destructor disconnects it and waits for the device.
